rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An expression revised in another one.
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-new-features/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsPreviousVersionOf") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A revision has the intent to alter or update the content of the prior expression, but without changing the content so much that it becomes a new work.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has revision
